technologyBaseline.security: Spring Security OAuth2 Resource Server / JWT

conventions.gatewayRule: Only public/admin /api/v1/** routes are exposed by API Gateway; /internal/v1/** is direct service-to-service only.
conventions.pagination: page, size, sort with a stable Page response

infrastructure.purpose: Public routing, JWT enforcement, correlation propagation, rate limiting

services.name: Identity and Access Service
services.scope: Manages application users, profiles, roles, permissions, and role-derived menus. JWT issuance may be delegated to an enterprise authorization server, while this service remains the source for Moneybags application authorization data.
services.owns: Users, application profiles, roles, permissions, menu definitions, and role assignments.
services.doesNotOwn: CIF/customer records, KYC evidence, bank accounts, or financial transactions.

endpoints.purpose: Resolve roles and permissions for a trusted caller

services.name: CIF / Customer Service
services.scope: Creates and maintains the bank customer record, contact data, customer classification, and the synchronized KYC status used by downstream account-opening services.
services.owns: CIF identity, customer demographics, contact details, employment data, customer status, and the current KYC status snapshot.
services.doesNotOwn: KYC documents or decisions, product rules, deposit accounts, credit-card accounts, or notification delivery.

endpoints.purpose: Create a customer and initiate KYC
Provide customer and KYC eligibility for deposit opening
Provide customer and KYC eligibility for card application
Confirm ownership of a referenced account

services.name: KYC Service
services.scope: Runs KYC cases from initiation through document upload, verification, review, and final decision, then synchronously updates the CIF KYC snapshot.
services.owns: KYC cases, customer snapshots used for review, document metadata/content references, verification results, and decisions.
services.doesNotOwn: The canonical customer record, notification delivery, account opening, or product eligibility rules.

endpoints.purpose: Search KYC cases by CIF and status
Upload KYC document metadata and content
Download or preview a KYC document
Approve or reject the KYC case

services.name: Product Master Service
services.scope: Defines reusable deposit and credit-card products, lifecycle, eligibility, pricing, effective-dated interest policies, fees, limits, and reference benchmarks.
services.owns: Product definitions and versions, eligibility rules, fee rules, pricing, interest policies, card terms, and benchmarks.
services.doesNotOwn: Customer/account state, balances, cards, transactions, bills, or journals.

endpoints.purpose: Delete a draft or discontinue an unused product
Get effective fees, rates, and calculation rules
Validate a proposed deposit account opening

services.name: Deposit Account Service
services.scope: Opens and manages deposit accounts, holders, nominees, mandates, limits, lifecycle, balance projection, operational holds, and peer-service eligibility.
services.owns: Deposit account identity and lifecycle, holder/nominee/mandate configuration, account-level limits, operational reservations, and balance read projections.
services.doesNotOwn: Product rules, CIF/KYC truth, immutable accounting journals, payment orchestration, or statements.

endpoints.notes: confirm-close uses both dependency checks; other lifecycle commands are local

endpoints.purpose: Validate ownership, status, currency, limits, and balances
Get a peer-safe deposit account snapshot
Capture a reservation after accounting posts
Release a reservation after failure or cancellation
Apply an atomic source/target balance projection update
Report account blockers for daily close

services.name: Credit Card Service
services.scope: Processes credit-card applications and owns credit-card accounts, limits, outstanding state, and card-specific posting projections.
services.owns: Card applications, approved limits, card account identity/status, available-limit projection, outstanding amount, and account-level interest snapshots.
services.doesNotOwn: Product rules, CIF/KYC truth, payment orchestration, bills, statements, or accounting journals.

endpoints.purpose: Open an account for an approved application
Get a peer-safe credit-card account snapshot
Apply a completed bill payment projection
Report card-account blockers for daily close

services.name: Payments Service
services.scope: Orchestrates book transfers, credit-card payments, merchant payments, cancellation, settlement, reversal, and refund states through synchronous peer APIs.
services.owns: Payment requests, payment lifecycle, orchestration attempts, idempotency results, and peer-call outcome evidence.
services.doesNotOwn: Account balances, card limits, customer contacts, product rules, or accounting journals.

endpoints.purpose: Create and synchronously execute a payment
Search settled and exceptional payments by account and date

services.name: Accounting Service
services.scope: Maintains the authoritative double-entry record, accounting rules, GL accounts, subledger mappings, journals, trial balances, financial reconciliation, and accounting periods.
services.owns: Immutable journals and lines, reversals, GL master, rule versions, mappings, posting idempotency, trial balances, financial reconciliation, and periods.
services.doesNotOwn: Payment lifecycle, customer/account truth, product definitions, bills, statements, or EOD orchestration.

endpoints.purpose: Get an authoritative journal-derived account balance
List journal lines for an account and date range
Post bill fees and interest as an immutable journal
Activate or deactivate a GL account
Generate and persist a trial balance

services.name: Bill Generation Service
services.scope: Generates immutable credit-card bills from product rules, card snapshots, and authoritative financial activity, then exposes bill summaries to statements and payments.
services.owns: Billing cycles, bill headers, line items, calculation snapshots, bill status, and generation audit.
services.doesNotOwn: Card-account truth, product rules, accounting journals, customer contacts, statements, or notification delivery.

endpoints.purpose: Generate a bill for an account and period
Find bills by account and billing period
Complete or classify daily bill generation

services.name: Statement Service
services.scope: Builds downloadable deposit-account and credit-card statements from authoritative account, payment, bill, and customer-contact APIs.
services.owns: Statement requests, generation status, immutable generated document metadata, file references, and generation audit.
services.doesNotOwn: Accounts, payments, bills, accounting journals, customer truth, or notification delivery.

endpoints.notes: accountType selects the Deposit or Credit Card branch

endpoints.purpose: Generate scheduled statements and account summaries

services.name: Notification Service
services.scope: Creates and delivers templated email/SMS/in-app notifications for peer services and exposes a customer notification inbox.
services.owns: Notification templates, notification requests, channel payload snapshots, delivery attempts, and delivery status.
services.doesNotOwn: Customer contact truth, source business records, statements, bills, payments, or KYC decisions.

endpoints.purpose: List notifications for the authenticated CIF
Get notification status and safe content

services.name: EOD / Reconciliation Orchestrator
services.scope: Coordinates the business date and ordered synchronous end-of-day controls across Payments, Deposit, Credit Card, Billing, Accounting, Statements, and Notifications.
services.owns: Business date, EOD runs, step execution state, stable peer command references, orchestration exceptions, waivers, and close audit.
services.doesNotOwn: Peer-service business records, journals, account status, bill content, statements, or notifications.

endpoints.purpose: Get the current business date and cutoff state
Start one EOD run for a business date
Get EOD run and step status
Resolve or waive an EOD exception
Open the next business date after successful close

canonicalization.reason: All public business APIs are versioned.
Product reference APIs use the same version prefix.
Peer APIs are direct-service routes and are never gateway-public.
CIF eligibility snapshots are trusted peer contracts.
Name states the exact consumer use case.
Posting semantics replace an ambiguous complete command.
Bill-payment projection is distinct from purchases.
Bill generation is an EOD/operations command, not a customer API.
EOD operator APIs follow the public version convention.
Accounting peer APIs use the common internal prefix.

workflows.name: Customer onboarding and KYC
steps: Client creates CIF using POST /api/v1/cifs with Idempotency-Key.
CIF persists the customer, then calls KYC POST /api/v1/kycs using the same correlation ID.
Reviewers verify documents and decide the KYC case.
KYC calls CIF PATCH /internal/v1/cifs/{cifId}/kyc-status and Notification POST /internal/v1/notifications.

workflows.name: Deposit account opening
steps: Deposit reads CIF /internal/v1/cifs/{cifId}/deposit-creation-details.
Deposit reads Product /api/v1/products/{productCode} and validates via /internal/v1/products/{productCode}/validate-account-opening.
Deposit persists the account aggregate, audit row, and idempotency result in one Oracle transaction.
No accounting journal is created merely for account identity creation; opening funding is a Payment command.

workflows.name: Book transfer
steps: Payments validates both accounts through Deposit eligibility APIs and reserves source funds.
Payments posts the settlement fact to Accounting with the payment ID as the stable external reference.
After Journal POSTED, Payments calls Deposit /internal/v1/deposit-transfers and captures the reservation.
If projection settlement fails after accounting posts, Payments requests a journal reversal and releases the reservation.

workflows.name: Credit-card bill payment
steps: Payments validates and reserves the source deposit account and validates destination card status/limit context.
Accounting posts the debit/credit journal.
Payments captures the source reservation and calls Card /payment-postings to reduce outstanding and restore limit.
Payments stores SETTLED only after accounting and both projections succeed; otherwise it enters REVERSAL_PENDING.

workflows.name: Statement generation
steps: Statement verifies CIF ownership and reads the owning account service.
Deposit statements read Payments history; card statements also read Bill summaries and card account data.
The generated document is immutable and referenced by the Statement service.
Statement completion may request a notification; delivery failure does not invalidate the statement.

workflows.name: End-of-day closure
steps: EOD freezes the business-date cutoff and sends stable commandReference values to each peer.
Payments cutoff/drain and Deposit/Card readiness must complete before Billing and financial controls.
Accounting produces a trial balance and Payments reconciliation; critical differences block closure.
Statements and Notifications run under explicit blocking/warning policies, then Accounting closes the period and EOD opens the next date.
